title: SheetMason: bounded document-workflow validation
recordType: Curated summary of existing diagnostic records; not a new validation run

nativeTextWorkflow.method: First five pages from each of two native-text drawing sets, using one shared template, provisional visual references, explicit correction, and final approved diagnostic exports.
nativeTextWorkflow.note: Two other initial corrections were reference transcription errors; the retained source-literal references were corrected before final scoring.

scanCropExperiment.interpretation: Fixed-region reuse remained unreliable across the shifted scans.

limitations: Small development workflows with provisional references; not an independent OCR accuracy estimate.
Operator setup time, review time, and savings were not measured.
Export preservation and correct label recognition are separate properties.
The application remains a local alpha with conservative PDF feature restrictions.
Original drawing files are not redistributed with this summary.
